d001.note: Zoom p.081: in item 2 the opening parenthesis sits directly after الناس with no word space, unlike the wide gaps in items 1, 3 and 5. Kept as printed.

d002.note: Zoom p.081: item 4 prints الإخلاص(سبع with no space before the parenthesis, the same as item 2. Kept as printed.

d003.note: ٦- آية الكرسي is a standalone, centred bold title in the smaller title font. It titles the ayah below it and matches ٧- الباقيات الصالحات and الصلاة الإبراهيمية (### per STRUCTURE). Items 1-5 are different: larger, right-aligned bold list lines with no body.

d004.note: ٧- الباقيات الصالحات is a centred bold title line in the same font and position as الصلاة الإبراهيمية below it on p.082, so it is ###.

d005.note: 1000dpi zoom, last salawat line on p.082: وَعَلى has a fatha on و and on ع and none on ل (only the automatic small alif over ى). Line 3's وَعَلَى shows two fathas, so the difference is real.

d006.note: 1000dpi zoom: a kasra sits directly under the tail of the م in وَالأَوْهَامِ, clearly above the next line's harakat.

d007.note: 2400dpi zoom: only ONE kasra is printed under the تح ligature of الفاتحين, so A's two kasras are not in the print. The kasra cannot be assigned to ت or ح with certainty; following الغافرين (kasra on the first letter, none before ين), the best reading is الفَاتِحينَ, with the [؟:] marker kept.

d008.note: 1600 and 2400dpi zooms: one kasra under ف and none under the tail of ر, so the print is الغَافِرينَ. Compare النَّاصِرِينَ on the line above, which clearly has a second kasra under ر.

d009.note: 2400dpi zoom: only one kasra is printed under the لم ligature of الظالمين (the ي dots are separate), so A's two kasras are not in the print. Which letter it belongs to is unsure, so B's [؟:الظَّالِمينَ] is kept with its marker, as for d007. The nearby الرَّاحِمِينَ and الرَّازِقِينَ do print two kasras.

d010.note: Pixel measurement on p.084: the line ending [يس: ١-٩]. stops at x=0.227 while every justified line reaches about 0.18. It is visibly short (unjustified), and شَاهَتِ الوُجُوهُ (ثلاثًا). starts a new line, so by CONVENTIONS §6 (after a visibly short last line) it is its own paragraph.

extra_edits.note: 1600dpi zoom on p.083 line 4: السَّاتِرةِ has shadda+fatha on س, kasra under ت and kasra under ة, with no fatha on ر. Both keyers added the fatha.
